source: Rochdale Borough Council official councillor directory (verified 13 October 2026) and 25 February 2026 recorded budget vote; links in each record
coverage_note: The 60 serving councillors and wards were matched to the official Rochdale Borough Council directory on 13 October 2026. Named individual votes are attributed only from the 25 February 2026 final amended Budget Council roll call. The source does not name voting positions on all separate amendments or routine council decisions. Absence of a named vote does not indicate absence from a meeting or how someone voted.

votes.description: Recorded roll-call on the final budget resolution. This included a 4.99% headline district council tax increase and an agreed one-off 2% reduction. Separate amendments did not publish individual voting names in this record.
